abstract_sentences.text: Reasoning has emerged as a key capability of large language models.

evidence.anchor: Reasoning has emerged as a key capability

abstract_sentences.text: In linguistic tasks, this capability can be enhanced by self-improving techniques that refine reasoning paths for subsequent finetuning.

evidence.anchor: self-improving techniques that refine reasoning paths

abstract_sentences.text: However, extending these language-based self-improving approaches to vision language models (VLMs) presents a unique challenge: visual hallucinations in reasoning paths cannot be effectively verified or rectified.

evidence.anchor: visual hallucinations in reasoning paths cannot be effectively verified or rectified

abstract_sentences.text: Our solution starts with a key observation about visual contrast: when presented with a contrastive VQA pair, i.e., two visually similar images with synonymous questions, VLMs identify relevant visual cues more precisely.
abstract_sentences.comparison: single visual grounding versus contrastive pair

evidence.anchor: two visually similar images with synonymous questions

abstract_sentences.text: Motivated by this observation, we propose Visual Contrastive Self-Taught Reasoner (VC-STaR), a novel self-improving framework that leverages visual contrast to mitigate hallucinations in model-generated rationales.

evidence.anchor: propose Visual Contrastive Self-Taught Reasoner (VC-STaR)

abstract_sentences.text: We collect a diverse suite of VQA datasets, curate contrastive pairs according to multi-modal similarity, and generate rationales using VC-STaR.

evidence.anchor: curate contrastive pairs according to multi-modal similarity

abstract_sentences.text: Consequently, we obtain a new visual reasoning dataset, VisCoR-55K, which is then used to boost the reasoning capability of various VLMs through supervised finetuning.
abstract_sentences.transition: names the training artifact and use

evidence.anchor: new visual reasoning dataset, VisCoR-55K

abstract_sentences.text: Extensive experiments show that VC-STaR not only outperforms existing self-improving approaches but also surpasses models finetuned on the SoTA visual reasoning datasets, demonstrating that the inherent contrastive ability of VLMs can bootstrap their own visual reasoning.
abstract_sentences.comparison: existing self-improving and SoTA visual reasoning datasets
abstract_sentences.transition: places the strongest claim at the abstract end

evidence.anchor: outperforms existing self-improving approaches but also surpasses

experimental_design.name: base_model
experimental_design.description: Qwen2.5VL-7B is the primary base model; base inference uses a “think step by step” prompt in the main comparison.

evidence.anchor: we employ Qwen2.5VL-7B as the base model

experimental_design.name: fine_tuning
experimental_design.description: LLaMA-Factory; 3 epochs; full-parameter SFT; vision tower frozen; learning rate 1e-5; batch size 256.

evidence.anchor: finetune the model for 3 epochs via full-parameter supervised finetuning

experimental_design.name: inference
experimental_design.description: Finetuned inference follows standard VLM inference and does not require the contrastive pipeline used for rationale generation.

evidence.anchor: does not require such a contrastive pipeline

experimental_design.name: text_embedding
experimental_design.description: Question embeddings use GTE text embeddings.

evidence.anchor: We use GTE text embeddings to represent the questions

experimental_design.name: visual_embedding
experimental_design.description: Visual embeddings use a model built on ID-based visual metric learning; the paper contrasts global semantic VLM embeddings with instance-discriminative vision-only features before choosing its versatile model.

evidence.anchor: we build a versatile visual embedding model based on ID-based visual metric learning

experimental_design.name: pair_matching
experimental_design.description: Dataset-by-dataset counterpart retrieval uses cosine distance thresholds: φq=0.15; φv=0.5 for general images and 0.3 for icon/geometry/chart/graph.

evidence.anchor: the question similarity threshold φ_q is set to 0.15

experimental_design.name: rationale_generator
experimental_design.description: θ performs Thinking and Contrasting; Qwen2.5-72B is the open-source LLM ψ for Rethinking.

evidence.anchor: The LLM ψ used in the rethinking step … Qwen2.5-72B

experimental_design.name: data_sources
experimental_design.description: 21 VQA datasets across reasoning, graph/chart, math, general and OCR; category shares in Figure 2 are General 42.7%, Reasoning 25.0%, Math 15.7%, Graph/Chart 8.8%, OCR 7.8%.

evidence.anchor: We collect 21 VQA datasets spanning five categories

experimental_design.name: curation_scale
experimental_design.description: Appendix reports 240K raw pairs, 86K median-difficulty pairs after filtering, and final VisCoR-55K after rationale quality filtering.

final_judgment.single_storyline: Visual hallucinations make text-centric VLM self-improvement unreliable; same-question, visually similar counterparts induce a contrastive analysis that rethinks coarse rationales, yielding VisCoR-55K for single-image SFT.
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: Pair criteria, embedding thresholds, difficulty definition, Think/Contrast/Rethink equations, SFT setup, six-benchmark Table 1, grounding examples and four targeted analyses remain in the main body.
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Complete prompts, greedy first-match-exit/O(n²) curation detail, 240K→86K→55K flow, dataset statistics and additional rationale cases move to A.2–A.4.
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 establishes the contrast effect on initial failures; Figure 4 aligns the three-step pipeline with rationale text; Table 1 preserves per-task scores beside Avg.; Table 4 tests positive/negative pair mechanisms.
final_judgment.largest_gap: No human or full-corpus rationale-fidelity evaluation, no seed/uncertainty/runtime reporting, no threshold or post-processing ablation, and no independent causal isolation of contrast from hint, rethinking LLM and data composition.
final_judgment.transfer_rule: For visual reasoning, pair semantically anchored questions with visually similar but discriminative counterparts, use the comparison as evidence for rationale refinement, and retain per-task outcomes alongside aggregate scores.
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: Evidence covers 21 VQA datasets, three VLM model variants, six benchmarks, fixed thresholds and single reported scores; it does not establish performance on hard failures, uncovered tasks or deployment settings.

word_count_notes.token_method: PDF text-layer extraction with ASCII word regex; formulas, citations, figure/table text and headers affect estimates.
word_count_notes.section_sum_note: Module section estimates sum to 5894; the remainder is title/author/page-front matter and headers, retained under other.

layout_observations.columns: Predominantly two-column; Abstract centered narrow block.
layout_observations.float_pressure: Figures 1–7 and Tables 1–4 occupy large cross-column or multi-panel areas; pages 2,3,5,8,9,17,19 have high visual density.

theory_summary.formal_results: No theorem, lemma, proposition, corollary or proof.
theory_summary.equation_role: Four method equations define data transformation and three rationale-generation steps; they are core-chain equations rather than guarantees.
theory_summary.cognitive_appendix: A.1 uses prototype and structure-mapping theories as explanatory framing, not as a formal prediction or proved result.

research_questions: Can visual contrast rectify hallucination-contaminated rationales?
Does the curation generalize across VQA tasks and base models?
Do difficulty and counterpart type affect gains?
experimental_summary.controls: Base Model, VQA SFT and self-improving/off-the-shelf baselines; controlled GQA positive/negative/combined rows.
experimental_summary.matching: Question/image cosine-distance thresholds and median-difficulty selection; no reported data-leakage audit.
experimental_summary.reproduction_granularity: Core SFT and thresholds in §4.1; full prompts and greedy search in A.2–A.3; seeds/hardware/runtime absent.

results_summary.headline: VC-STaR Avg 58.1 versus Base 55.5; strongest displayed base-relative gains are MMVP +5.7, Hallusion +3.2 and MME-RW +3.4.
results_summary.statistical_reporting: Single benchmark scores, deltas and descriptive bars; no uncertainty, hypothesis tests, bootstrap, Bayesian analysis, regression or correlation.
results_summary.mechanism_evidence: Figure 1, Figure 5 and GQA Table 4 provide directional mechanism evidence; no independent mediation or component-isolation test.

ablation_summary.coverage: Pair construction, base model, easy sample inclusion and positive/negative counterpart type are tested.
ablation_summary.missing: No threshold, embedding, post-processing, hint-only, contrast-only or rethinking-LLM-only ablation.
ablation_summary.negative_results: Easy-sample addition is below 0K and data distribution changes performance across HQ-Edit/DOCCI/VisCoR.

appendix_summary.relative_length: Approximately 2606 text-layer words versus approximately 5936 main-body words; about 44% by this extraction.

lexical_analysis.source_scope: PDF pages 1–10 excluding References; citations, formulas and obvious table/figure fragments removed for interpretation, not raw repository aggregation.
lexical_analysis.strong_weak_pattern: Strong verbs/adjectives cluster in Abstract, §4.2, §4.3 and Conclusion; weak qualifiers cluster in examples and method caveats. Exact strong/weak ratio is not claimed because no reproducible syntactic classifier is supplied.
